note: Dojo's own synthetic deck spec for the fictional widget-sync lesson, as the author model would return it.
outcomes: Name the four stages of a sync run and what a failed validation stops
Choose push, pull or mirror mode for a site
Explain how retries grow and when a device counts as unreachable
Read a sync.yaml file and plan a staged rollout

steps.label: Validate
steps.note: a failed check stops the run here

tip.text: A run that fails validation delivers nothing, so devices keep their last good settings.
tip.quote: A run that fails validation stops before anything is delivered, so devices keep their last good settings.

layers.label: Hub administrators
layers.note: change sync for the whole hub

layers.label: Site operators
layers.note: change sync for their own sites only

layers.label: Device owners
layers.note: pause sync on one device for up to 24 hours

visual.label: How often a device in pull mode checks the hub, by default
visual.quote: In pull mode, each device checks the hub every 15 minutes by default.

tip.text: Shorter is not free: a shorter interval brings changes sooner but sends more requests to the hub.
tip.quote: A shorter interval delivers changes sooner but sends more requests to the hub.

steps.label: Wait
steps.note: 1 minute at first, then twice as long each time

steps.label: Try again
steps.note: the wait grows up to 60 minutes

tip.text: After 8 failed retries the device is marked unreachable and the hub stops trying until it checks in.
tip.quote: After 8 failed retries the device is marked as unreachable, and the hub stops trying until the device checks in again.

spokes.label: Reporter
spokes.note: sends the result back to the hub

tip.text: The verifier is a hard stop: a package whose signature does not verify is never applied.
tip.quote: A package whose signature does not verify is never applied.

marks.note: pull mode: each device asks the hub

tip.text: Before each stage, review the Sync health page.
tip.quote: Review the Sync health page before each stage.

recap: A sync run collects, validates, packages and delivers; a failed validation delivers nothing.
Hub administrators, site operators and device owners each reach a different level.
Push needs a live hub; pull and mirror keep working without it.
Retries wait 1 minute, then double up to 60; 8 failures mark a device unreachable.
sync.yaml sets the mode, interval, quiet window and retries; big changes roll out in stages.

left.title: Needs a live hub link
points: Push mode delivers only while the hub connection is live

right.title: Keeps working offline
points: Mirror mode serves the last copy the relay received
